name: Close-Grip Lat Pulldown
summary: A pulldown with a narrow neutral-grip (V) handle that allows a longer range of motion and a comfortable wrist and shoulder position. Trains the lats, mid back and biceps.
setup: Attach a V-handle or neutral-grip bar and secure your thighs under the pad.
Grab the handle with palms facing each other and sit tall.
Lean back slightly and let the arms extend with the shoulders set.
execution: Pull the shoulder blades down to start.
Drive the elbows down and back along your sides.
Bring the handle to the upper chest or sternum.
Return slowly until the arms are straight.
mistakes: Rocking the torso to move the weight: lower the load and keep the lean fixed.
Shortening the stretch at the top: let the arms fully extend each rep.
Pulling with the biceps only: think elbows down, not hands down.
Letting the shoulders roll forward: keep the chest up.
